stem: A sensor value is plausible but its required verification interval is overdue. How should the reading be handled?
choices: Present it as fully verified because the number looks normal
Preserve the reading but document the verification-status limitation and follow the supplied process
Adjust protected calibration settings without authorization
rationale: Preserve the reading but document the verification-status limitation and follow the supplied process. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
